notes: SO must have an active eRA Commons account with SO role registered by the institution. PI selects SO from a pre-populated list of registered SOs at their institution. SO identity is pulled from eRA — institution must ensure SO is registered in eRA Commons before PI submits.

SO logs into dbGaP Authorized Access System using eRA credentials and reviews the PI's full application. SO may edit the forms or return them to the PI. SO's electronic co-signature legally binds the institution (the 'Requester') to the Data Use Certification Agreement for phs003428. This is the institution's primary required action.

field_type: structured contact form (name + title + org + address + phone + email)
notes: Institution must designate a senior IT official as IT Director. The IT Director must be from the institution (not a personal email). For phs003428 the IT Director affirms the institution's IT security meets NIH Security Best Practices for Controlled-Access Data (NIST SP 800-171 as of Jan 25 2025). IT Director becomes an Approved User bound by the DUC.

required_by: Institutional Signing Official (SO) / PI (uploaded by PI but SO assures)
notes: The SO assures through DAR co-signature that relevant institutional policies including IRB approval (if required) have been followed. For phs003428 the study page must be checked for IRB requirement. If required the PI uploads the IRB approval PDF but the SO's signature constitutes the institutional assurance of compliance.

field_type: electronic confirmation in dbGaP portal at project close-out
notes: At project close-out or expiration the SO must confirm destruction of all copies of the phs003428 dataset (local servers + cloud). Failure by SO to complete this step may result in suspension of the PI and all associated personnel. This is an institution-level obligation under the DUC Article 11.

field_type: institutional registration with NIH eRA Commons (DUNS number required)
notes: Institution must be registered in NIH eRA Commons before any PI at that institution can submit a DAR. Requires DUNS number. Handled by the institution's business/grants office. Prerequisite for all dbGaP access requests.
